categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches `dumptxoutset` argument validation in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` and bears the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Prevents a daemon crash when invoking `dumptxoutset` with a rollback on AssumeUTXO snapshots. The PR description notes that calling `dumptxoutset` with a rollback parameter on a pruned or syncing snapshot node currently 'triggers an assertion and terminates the node' when disconnecting blocks without block or undo data; returning an RPC error restores interface stability.
